description: Detect the substrates a target scenario actually contains and run only the applicable scanners; unsupported substrates emit an INFO observation rather than a failure.

requirements.title: Filesystem substrate detection
requirements.description: A detector must walk a scenario's api/, ui/src/, and cli/ directories plus lockfile presence (go.mod, pnpm-lock.yaml) and classify which substrates exist (Go, pnpm UI), returning a structured result that also lists substrates seen but unsupported (e.g. Python).

validation.notes: Given a scenario with go.mod, the detector reports the Go substrate present.
Given a scenario with pnpm-lock.yaml under ui/, the detector reports the pnpm UI substrate present.
Given a scenario with a requirements.txt (Python), the detector records it under Unsupported, not as a failure.

requirements.title: Applicable-scanner selection
requirements.description: ValidateScenario must run only the scanners whose Applies(substrate) returns true for the detected substrates, and must aggregate their findings into one normalized result set.

validation.notes: A Go-only scenario invokes gosec/govulncheck but not pnpm audit.
A scenario with both Go and pnpm UI invokes scanners for both substrates and merges findings.
